items.item: Each category in the tree shows a product count, the page states whether counts include subcategories, and in the sample data every parent's total equals its own products plus the totals of its children
items.evidence: Tree column 'Sản phẩm' renders totalProducts(n) (page.html:569,584) which recursively sums own + children; detail panel explicitly labels the same figure 'Tổng sản phẩm (gồm danh mục con)' i.e. 'incl. subcategories' (line 713) alongside 'Sản phẩm trực tiếp' (direct-only, line 709), clarifying what the tree number includes. Verified against sample data: Thời trang shows 2.301 = own 12 + tt-nam 878 + tt-nu 1.184 + tt-te 182 + tt-pk 45; Điện tử shows 1.123 = own 5 + 599 + 223 + 263 + 33 — both match screenshot figures.

items.item: The tree exposes its structure to screen readers (role="tree" and "treeitem", or nested lists) with aria-expanded on parent nodes and the selected node marked, and nodes can be expanded, collapsed and selected from the keyboard
items.evidence: Markup uses the WAI-ARIA treegrid pattern instead of role=tree/treeitem or nested lists: table role="treegrid" with tr role="row" (page.html:112,575-578) carrying aria-level, aria-posinset, aria-setsize, aria-expanded on parent rows, and aria-selected on the chosen row. This is a recognized equivalent for hierarchical tabular data (multiple columns: name/count/status) rather than the literal tree/treeitem roles named in the checklist. Keyboard support is implemented fully: ArrowUp/Down move focus, ArrowRight/Left expand/collapse or go to parent, Home/End, '*' expands siblings, Enter/Space selects, and type-ahead by first letter (page.html:845-909).

items.item: Searching by name keeps the ancestors of each matching category visible and expanded so its place in the hierarchy is clear, and a search with no matches says so
items.evidence: getKeepSetForSearch (page.html:477-493) walks all nodes, and for every match adds the node plus all its parentOf ancestors to a 'keep' set; getVisibleRows forces isExpanded=true for every kept node while searching (line 505). When matchCount is 0, #tree-no-results is shown with text 'Không tìm thấy danh mục nào khớp "<query>"' (lines 135-138, 554-558).

items.item: The detail panel shows the selected category's full path (such as "Home › Kitchen › Cookware"), name, URL slug, parent, visibility status, product count with a link to those products, and the last modified date and user
items.evidence: Breadcrumb path (line 633-636), name as h2 (line 684), status badge (line 685), 'Tổng sản phẩm' stat and a 'Xem tất cả N sản phẩm...' link (line 674), and 'Thay đổi lần cuối bởi X · <time>' (line 742) are all present. However there is no URL slug field — the only identifier shown is 'Mã danh mục' (code), and the form explicitly documents it as internal-only: 'Dùng để tra cứu nội bộ, không hiển thị trên cửa hàng' (line 199, 'used for internal lookup, not shown on the storefront'), i.e. explicitly not a public URL slug. There is also no explicit 'Parent' field in the detail view (only implied via the breadcrumb).

items.item: Hidden or inactive categories are marked in the tree with a text label or icon (such as "Hidden"), not only by greying out
items.evidence: statusBadge() renders a pill with the text 'Ngừng bán' (Discontinued/inactive) in both the tree status column (line 585) and the detail header (line 685) whenever status === 'inactive', e.g. nodes 'Đồ bơi' and 'Vitamin tổng hợp mới' in the sample data (lines 378, 391).

items.item: Deleting a category that still has products or subcategories is blocked or requires choosing where to move them, and the confirmation names the category and the counts affected
items.evidence: openDeleteConfirm (page.html:1210-1223) checks own>0 || children>0 and, if true, shows a blocking dialog titled 'Không thể xóa' with body 'Không thể xóa {name}: danh mục có {N} sản phẩm và {M} danh mục con...' and showOk:false (no confirm action possible), naming both the category and the exact counts.

items.item: A category can be given a new parent without drag-and-drop (a parent picker or "Move to…" action), and the picker excludes the category itself and its own descendants
items.evidence: No reparenting UI exists anywhere. The edit dialog shows the parent only as read-only text (#category-parent-path, lines 187-190, 1027-1033) with no selector to change it, and the detail panel's overflow menu only offers 'Thêm danh mục con', activate/deactivate, and 'Xóa danh mục' (lines 696-701) — no 'Move to…' action or parent picker of any kind.

items.item: Selecting another category while the detail form has unsaved edits asks to save or discard first
items.evidence: selectNode() (page.html:747-762) and the tree click handler (816-828) apply selection immediately with no dirty-check. The edit form's Cancel/X/backdrop-click handlers all call closeCategoryModal() directly (lines 1050-1056) which just hides the dialog with no confirmation of unsaved changes, and there's no guard preventing navigation elsewhere while edits are pending.

items.item: With nothing selected the detail panel shows a prompt instead of blank fields, a catalogue with no categories offers to create the first one, and the tree has loading and load-error-with-retry states
items.evidence: #detail-empty shows 'Chọn một danh mục để xem thông tin chi tiết' with an add button when !selectedId (lines 160-165, 621-625); #tree-empty shows 'Chưa có danh mục sản phẩm nào' plus a 'Thêm danh mục' button for pageState==='empty' (lines 125-129, 544-548); #tree-skeleton renders animated placeholder rows for pageState==='loading' (122-124, 536-538) and #tree-error shows 'Không tải được cây danh mục' with a '#tree-retry' button that resets pageState to 'normal' (130-134, 540-542, 987-990). All three states are reachable via ?state=empty|error|loading.

notes: No template tells observed: header has no greeting, stat tiles use plain numbers with no icons, no gradients/glass (audit.json confirms 0 hardStopGradients and no backdrop-blur violations), status uses a single grey pill (not rainbow), nav section labels are not uppercase-tracked, all icons are inline SVG (no emoji), radii are a consistent 6px (not oversized), and the sidebar is plain white with a blue accent rather than navy/indigo. Automated audit.json score is 90/100, with the only violation being text-contrast (×30, e.g. sidebar section labels and the '· CODE' secondary text at 2.56:1 vs 4.5:1 required) — not part of the checklist but worth flagging. Biggest functional gaps: no URL slug field, no way to reparent an existing category, and no unsaved-changes guard when switching selection.
